name: Hubspot API
description: Provides a library to easily integrate with the Hubspot API.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Purpose 
 The main purpose of this module is to provide a Drupal-friendly API integration with Hubspot. It is mainly for developers. This module leverages a third-party PHP SDK for this integration.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Primarily, this module provides the configuration (keys and Oauth settings) and Drupal-specific wrappers around the SDK. In the 7 version, this module also offers a Drupal-sponsored backup solution for HubSpot CRM.

 Back to top 

 Example Uses 
 Drupal 8/9/10 
 Provides a hubspot_api.manager service. See README.md for more detailed info.

 Back to top 

 Related Modules 
 The Hubspot module is a Webform-specific implementation of Hubspot and may leverage this module in the future.

 Back to top 

 Installation / Set-up 
 This module requires a Hubspot API key for proper configuration.
